ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
MBIRTorch performs Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction (MBIR) for
tomographic reconstruction using PyTorch.

Features include:

* Multiple geometries: parallel beam, cone beam (including curved
  detector and helical), translation mode, and multi-axis parallel.
* 4D reconstruction: a time sequence of volumes from a single
  continuous scan, using multi-agent consensus equilibrium (MACE).
* Preprocessing routines for NSI and Zeiss scanners, plus geometry
  calibration.
* Utilities for metal artifact reduction and stripe removal.
* Interactive slice and geometry viewers.
* Demos and documentation.
* Operation on one or more GPUs, Mac MPS, or CPU.
* Compiled torch and Triton kernels for efficiency.

name: mbirtorch
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: mbirtorch
  version: "0.1.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 87ba3f3efd096cd9d8fbb406d81840c52abb7118d6d484cd1d12faf4d5005cee

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=61
    - wheel
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pytorch >=2.13
    - numpy
    - scipy
    - matplotlib-base
    - pillow
    - h5py
    - tifffile
    - tqdm
    - pywavelets
    - osqp
    - opencv
    - olefile
    - gdown
    - scikit-learn
    - psutil

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - mbirtorch
        - mbirtorch.preprocess
        - mbirtorch.hsnt
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/cabouman/mbirtorch
  summary: High-performance tomographic reconstruction using PyTorch
  description: |
    MBIRTorch performs Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction (MBIR) for
    tomographic reconstruction using PyTorch.

    Features include:

    * Multiple geometries: parallel beam, cone beam (including curved
      detector and helical), translation mode, and multi-axis parallel.
    * 4D reconstruction: a time sequence of volumes from a single
      continuous scan, using multi-agent consensus equilibrium (MACE).
    * Preprocessing routines for NSI and Zeiss scanners, plus geometry
      calibration.
    * Utilities for metal artifact reduction and stripe removal.
    * Interactive slice and geometry viewers.
    * Demos and documentation.
    * Operation on one or more GPUs, Mac MPS, or CPU.
    * Compiled torch and Triton kernels for efficiency.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://mbirtorch.readthedocs.io
  repository: https://github.com/cabouman/mbirtorch

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - cabouman
    - gbuzzard
